activity_summary: You wrote Item, cloves, ij d., a pennyworth on the way home and another for the night. You did not open the coffer. You wrote till ten on nothing but stubbornness, and the page did not become a scene.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the line, wrote till ten, and stopped.

entities.name: twopence
entities.context: Mentioned in Item, cloves, ij d.
